note: Dungeon looks (core/game/game_dungeon_art.gd, ui/play/dungeon_view.gd, ui/play/dungeon_entrance_art.gd; checked by tools/check_data.gd). `dungeons` gives each dungeon place its theme. A theme has a `palette` (a character is a colour) and 8 by 8 pixel `glyphs` ('.' is clear): the floor in three looks (floor_a, floor_b, floor_c, chosen by a hash of the tile), wall_face (a wall with floor to its south), wall_top, door, exit, and the props it uses. `shared.containers` are the shapes of the loot containers (chest, crate, rack, hoard, urn, sarcophagus, each closed and `_open`), coloured by the theme's `containers` colours (M main, N dark, H light, T trim, P black). `propdefs` say what each prop is (name, whether it blocks the way, the radius of light it gives, whether it hangs on a wall). `ambient` rules place props from the dungeon's id alone (`where`: floor, edge, corner, center, pillar, head, wall_north; `roles` limits them to rooms of those roles). `light` is the darkness (0 to 1), the heir's own light radius in tiles and a tint. `entrance` is the dungeon's door drawn on the open world, w by h tiles of 16 pixels, the door tile at the bottom middle. Nothing here is saved or random.
